title: Hold'em
description: Texas Hold'em for two to six people and one phone. Real felt, real chips, and a full rules engine: blinds that rotate and climb, minimum raises, side pots when somebody is all in for less, and an exact seven-card evaluator that ranks all twenty-one hands and splits the pot on a true tie. Your two hole cards live behind a cover that names whoever should be holding the phone and closes again the moment they act — everything else, the board, the pot and every bet, stays face up for the whole table.
